title: 6 more puzzles. 6 more traps.
blocks: Six more puzzles, and six more answers that feel obviously right. A pattern that breaks at six. A party that always hides a triangle. A test that is nowhere near ninety-nine percent. A treatment that wins and loses at the same time. A line of prisoners. And an ant that outruns infinity. Grab a pencil, because in every one of them, we show our work.
